purpose: P10/#1012: enforce the import/global/cycle boundary rules of app-js.profile.json for the migrated application slice through the normal local boundaries gate, while classifying the unmigrated classic-script files honestly: their relationships are not resolved by the lexical checker (script-tag globals carry no import edges), so they receive a no-growth ceiling on their existing findings instead of a fictional dependency-graph pass.

checker.resolves: literal require()/import specifiers between declared modules, window.SM* global access, size, expired exceptions, import cycles
checker.doesNotResolve: references between classic scripts through document-scope globals (e.g. NemoExportJob, SMEngineBridge without the window. prefix); those edges are NOT analyzed and are reported as unresolved, never as passing

legacyUnresolvedNote: Count of checker findings in legacy layers at adoption (main b4a4fe249821bc534dd1a63dbb4b037df6455ec3: 439 global-state + 4 unsupported-global + 2 unsupported-import + 1 unprofiled-local-import in app-legacy, 1 global-state in app-domain, 2 global-state in app-presentation-adapter). The ceiling may only go down; lowering it is the ordinary change that accompanies a migration or repair.
